part1.title: Part 1 · Match nodes in static drawings
part1.instruction: The four highlighted nodes on the left form a path. Select the same four nodes in the drawing on the right, shown at a different aspect ratio.
part1.targetsNote: Four consecutive path vertices, identical across ARCOL and DARCOL for each graph.

part2.title: Part 2 · Remember a tree’s direction across an animation
part2.instruction: Look at the unmarked drawing for six seconds, then watch its one-second animation. After playback, one tree is marked red. Which direction did that tree point in the first drawing?

part2.targetsNote: Same attached tree and AR pair across methods. Correct original direction is scored separately from each method’s initial layout.
part2.targetSelectionPolicy: Same complete attached target tree and same AR pair in both methods; direction changes and preservation cases are recorded separately.

part3.title: Compare two animations
part3.instruction: Watch two animations of the same graph, starting from the same drawing and resizing to the same target aspect ratio. Give one overall preference rating.

questions.text: Which animation do you prefer overall?

part3.presentationStyle: Black 2px edges and square borders, #848482 interiors, 4px rounded corners; spacing-limited 18px square nodes; Part 2 arc-length route correspondence.
part3.endpointPolicy: Same DARCOL starting drawing; independently computed ARCOL final layout versus DARCOL final layout at the same target aspect ratio.
part3.portAttachment: Preserve offset end-segment lines with short normal connectors and clip at the square boundary; never pull long route segments to node centers.
